document_provenance_in_cache.note: ents_meta.json carries only id/name/types/descr - NO per-entity document, chunk or source field, and no other r47/r50 cache carries one. Components in b_coverage_UNDETERMINABLE are 'no identity twin found AND not tiny' - the coverage claim itself is NOT verified.
